proposition: Melvin-Koushki presumes the R. Iʿtiqādiyya was written around the time of the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (ca. 832-35/1429-32) because it mentions the R. Iʿtiqādāt; this reasoning gives only a lower bound (after 829/1426), and the work is otherwise undated and survives only in Majlis 10196 f. 171b.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, in the R. Iʿtiqādiyya
mediation.note: a statement of creed offered to defend his learning
